title: One hair, three kinds of touch neuron

scenes.tts: On a mouse's back, one kind of hair follicle is fenced by the endings of three kinds of touch neuron. It is called the awl aw keen hair, and this is in mouse trunk skin. Each kind sends its own signal to the spinal cord. Each signal has its own speed. Why build a sense this way?
scenes.caption: On a mouse's back, one kind of hair follicle is fenced by the endings of three kinds of touch neuron. It is called the awl/auchene hair, and this is in mouse trunk skin. Each kind sends its own signal to the spinal cord. Each signal has its own speed. Why build a sense this way?
scenes.visual: A hair follicle with three colours of pickets around it fades in; three coloured axons run down toward a labelled spinal cord arrow.
scenes.narration: On a mouse's back, one kind of hair follicle is fenced by the endings of three kinds of touch neuron. It is called the awl/auchene hair, and this is in mouse trunk skin. Each kind sends its own signal to the spinal cord. Each signal has its own speed. Why build a sense this way?

scenes.tts: Each of these kinds ends in lan see oh late endings. A lan see oh late ending is an axon branch running along the follicle, parallel to the hair shaft. It is like one picket in a fence. Terminal Schwann cells interleave with the pickets. These are non-neuronal cells. At this hair the three classes are A beta R A, A delta, and C.
scenes.caption: Each of these kinds ends in lanceolate endings. A lanceolate ending is an axon branch running along the follicle, parallel to the hair shaft. It is like one picket in a fence. Terminal Schwann cells interleave with the pickets. These are non-neuronal cells. At this hair the three classes are Aβ RA, Aδ, and C.
scenes.visual: Follicle zooms in; pickets pulse as parallel to the shaft; purple Schwann cell blobs appear between pickets; class labels attach to the three colours.
scenes.narration: Each of these kinds ends in lanceolate endings. A lanceolate ending is an axon branch running along the follicle, parallel to the hair shaft. It is like one picket in a fence. Terminal Schwann cells interleave with the pickets. These are non-neuronal cells. At this hair the three classes are Aβ RA, Aδ, and C.

scenes.tts: The three classes differ in speed. In mouse hairy skin, recorded in a preparation of skin, nerve, ganglion and spinal cord, the A beta R A neurons conduct at thirteen point six metres per second. The A delta neurons conduct at five point eight. The C neurons conduct at zero point five eight. The C signal is by far the slowest.
scenes.caption: The three classes differ in speed. In mouse hairy skin, recorded in a preparation of skin, nerve, ganglion and spinal cord, the Aβ RA neurons conduct at 13.6 metres per second. The Aδ neurons conduct at 5.8. The C neurons conduct at 0.58. The C signal is by far the slowest.
scenes.visual: Follicle shrinks left; a bar chart of mean conduction velocity grows three bars to scale, with the lesson's values.
scenes.narration: The three classes differ in speed. In mouse hairy skin, recorded in a preparation of skin, nerve, ganglion and spinal cord, the Aβ RA neurons conduct at 13.6 metres per second. The Aδ neurons conduct at 5.8. The C neurons conduct at 0.58. The C signal is by far the slowest.

scenes.tts: How did anyone learn which endings belong to which neurons? Li and colleagues labelled the C, A delta and A beta R A classes genetically. They confirmed their identity by recording. No mouse line for S A one neurons existed yet. So they marked S A one endings by staining the Merkel cells they contact. Then they imaged whole mounts of mouse trunk skin. Guard hairs carry A beta R A endings, plus endings in a touch dome beside the hair. Awl aw keen hairs carry A beta R A, A delta, and C. Zigzag hairs carry A delta and C.
scenes.caption: How did anyone learn which endings belong to which neurons? Li and colleagues labelled the C, Aδ and Aβ RA classes genetically. They confirmed their identity by recording. No mouse line for SA1 neurons existed yet. So they marked SA1 endings by staining the Merkel cells they contact. Then they imaged whole mounts of mouse trunk skin. Guard hairs carry Aβ RA endings, plus endings in a touch dome beside the hair. Awl/auchene hairs carry Aβ RA, Aδ, and C. Zigzag hairs carry Aδ and C.
scenes.visual: Three steps (label, record, image) chain across; then three hair types appear, each with its own mix of coloured pickets.
scenes.narration: How did anyone learn which endings belong to which neurons? Li and colleagues labelled the C, Aδ and Aβ RA classes genetically. They confirmed their identity by recording. No mouse line for SA1 neurons existed yet. So they marked SA1 endings by staining the Merkel cells they contact. Then they imaged whole mounts of mouse trunk skin. Guard hairs carry Aβ RA endings, plus endings in a touch dome beside the hair. Awl/auchene hairs carry Aβ RA, Aδ, and C. Zigzag hairs carry Aδ and C.

scenes.tts: Now count, in an idealized patch of one hundred follicles. Use the dominant map only, and leave out field L T M Rs. The three hair types occur in an approximate ratio of one guard, twenty three awl aw keen, and seventy six zigzag. A beta R A is found at twenty four follicles. A beta S A one is found at one. A delta is found at ninety nine. C is found at ninety nine. The total is two hundred twenty three.
scenes.caption: Now count, in an idealized patch of 100 follicles. Use the dominant map only, and leave out field-LTMRs. The three hair types occur in an approximate ratio of 1 guard, 23 awl/auchene, and 76 zigzag. Aβ RA is found at 24 follicles. Aβ SA1 is found at 1. Aδ is found at 99. C is found at 99. The total is 223.
scenes.visual: Three ratio chips; rows build per class (Abeta RA, Abeta SA1, Adelta, C) as the matching hair chips pulse; the total line adds them to 223.
scenes.narration: Now count, in an idealized patch of 100 follicles. Use the dominant map only, and leave out field-LTMRs. The three hair types occur in an approximate ratio of 1 guard, 23 awl/auchene, and 76 zigzag. Aβ RA is found at 24 follicles. Aβ SA1 is found at 1. Aδ is found at 99. C is found at 99. scenes.tts: Is two hundred twenty three a count of neurons? No. One neuron contacts many follicles. A single mouse field L T M R reached twenty to one hundred eighty follicles. And the ratio counts hairs, not neurons. So the sum tells you how often each class appears at a hair. Keep this rule. Endings at a hair are not a count of neurons.
scenes.caption: Is 223 a count of neurons? No. One neuron contacts many follicles. A single mouse field-LTMR reached 20 to 180 follicles. And the ratio counts hairs, not neurons. So the sum tells you how often each class appears at a hair. Keep this rule. Endings at a hair are not a count of neurons.
